title: Cursed fate: Missions
description: This mod makes the Quest Board availabe again so you can have quicker and faster progressing
body:
**This mod is only made for the versions that have the board disabled! it might not work when it's enabled again!**

This mod makes the **quest board from cursed fate** be available again, so you can grind masteries more easily!

How it works is under the spoiler


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

To pick a mission, you need to click on the notes with a specific mission. the white notes are the basic missions and the gold ones ( yellow ones ) are the elite missions

</details>

All the Basic missions are under the spoiler


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

-    Exterminate X [ Aggressive Mobs like creepers, zombies etc.]
-    Travel X blocks    Gather X [Items like wood, gunpowder etc.]
-    Travel to the nether
-    Eat Food X times
-    Spend X Cursed Energy
-    Breed X animals
-    One Shot any mob
-    Discover a structure
-    Restore X HP
-    Plant X [Vegetables/plants or any]
-    Complete an advancement
-    Use Any ability X times
-    Defeat any player [Only in multiplayer]

</details>


  
All the Elite mission are under this spoiler
  
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

-    Exterminate a mob [ harder mobs like warden, wither skeletons, the curses etc. ]
-    Land a blackflash 1-3 times
-    One-shot a powerful mob [like warden, Golem, Ravager etc. ]
-    Complete a Challenge advancement
-    Use the Next Ability You Cast X times
-    Maintain a Domain for 30 seconds
-    Restore X hp using rct
-    Defeat a specific player [only in multiplayer]
-    Collect [20 or more] items

</details>


   
You can change a mission when you click on another note

You can also add missions so you can have multiple active ones at a time [ to remove a quest you press k on your keyboard, you can also change the keybind of it in the settings ]


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

There is also one secret quest that is very rare.

</details>

You can add suggestions for quests in the comments or tell bugs! ( Curseforge Page )

Made in MCreator

 

There were supposed to be use a specific ability quest but cursed fate sadly didn't have anything to make it work, no tags, no nbts, nothing
